body: The True Heart Q: Whai is the True Heart? A: The True Heart is the place where you always know how things are. It is aplace of absolute confirmation and absolute affirmation. It is where everything is always revealed. If someone is truly Enlightened then the Heart 1am speaking about is their only home. It is the source of who and what they are. In this True Heart everything is always known. It is always perfect fullness. Out of that perfect fullness comes self-arising wisdom. When you discover the True Heart you will know how to walk through life with courage and dignity.
